name: Menacing Swordplay
body:
Menacing Swordplay (Ex)
Source Advanced Class Guide pg. 57
At 3rd level, while she has at least 1 panache point, when a swashbuckler hits an opponent with a light or one-handed piercing melee weapon, she can choose to use Intimidate to demoralize that opponent (Pathfinder RPG Core Rulebook 99) as a swift action instead of a standard action.
